faqs.question: Who can vote in India?
faqs.answer: Any Indian citizen aged 18 or above on the qualifying date (usually Jan 1st of the year) can vote, provided they are enrolled in the voter list.

faqs.question: What documents are required to register?
faqs.answer: You need a recent passport-size photograph, an age proof (like Birth Certificate, Aadhaar, PAN), and an address proof (like Passport, Utility Bill).

faqs.question: What if I lose my Voter ID card?
faqs.answer: If you are on the electoral roll, you can still vote by showing alternative approved photo IDs like Aadhaar, PAN card, Driving License, or Passport.
